style: Single isolated sound effect for a warm cartoon martial-arts card game. Clean close dry recording, immediate attack, short natural decay, no background noise, no speech, no music bed, no long reverb.

sounds.prompt: One quick dry paper-card swish with a tiny cloth flick, moving decisively onto a tabletop. Soft tactile card-play gesture.
One light reversed paper flutter and soft wooden tap, a card returning to a hand. Gentle, lighter than a played card.
One compact confident wood-and-clay locking click with a restrained low thump. A chosen move is locked in.
One brisk double paper snap opening into a clean airy swish. Two hidden cards turn face up together, a shared reveal.
One short crisp paper ignition, small flame whoosh and dry ember crackle that quickly dies away. Spending a card as a bonus.
One sharp immediate paper ignition with a tight high flame hiss and tiny dry snap. Fast reactive card burn, distinct from a slower bonus burn.
One light cartoon martial-arts body impact: dry padded slap, tiny cloth snap, restrained low thud. Friendly sparring, no voices.
One firm cartoon martial-arts body impact: rounded padded thwack and short cloth snap, punchy wooden low-mid knock. No voices.
One powerful cartoon martial-arts impact: deep padded whump layered with a crisp dry smack and brief air rush. Weighty but playful, no voices.
One clean martial-arts forearm block, tight woody clack over padded cloth thud, short deflecting air swish. No metallic sword sound.
One small warm ascending two-note wooden bell sparkle, a tactical opportunity earned. Subtle lyre-like pluck and rounded chime, not electronic.
One quick warm wooden chime unfurling into a short breathy release, a stored tactical opportunity being spent. Resolute, subtle.
One soft rounded magical shield pulse, low hollow ceramic ping with gentle airy shimmer, absorbing a blow without breaking.
One brittle magical barrier shattering, small crystalline crack, soft ceramic fragments and fading air. Clear but not harsh or glass-danger realism.
One deep solid wooden gate catch, a low resonant thunk with a brief magical hum stopping momentum. An HP checkpoint holds firm.
One rising strained ceramic crack followed by a deep clean break-through thump and tiny scattering sparkles. A resilient HP segment finally gives way.
One quiet unresolved wooden tick and small suspended magical ping. A pending damage mark is placed, tense but restrained.
One tight double impact, a dry tick resolving into a satisfying padded thump with a small warm chime. Follow-up damage is confirmed.
One quiet two-step bamboo tapping cue with a light upward air flick. An attentive invitation to respond, subtle and unobtrusive.
One gentle frame-drum pickup and warm short lyre pluck. A fresh exchange is ready, buoyant and encouraging.
One decisive deep padded cartoon knockout whump with a tight wooden crack, followed by a very short falling air swoop. Playful martial arts, no voice or pain.
One short celebratory acoustic game reward flourish: bright lyre-like plucks, warm wooden bell and a soft frame-drum finish. Cheerful respectful victory, no vocals.
One short gentle descending acoustic game outcome flourish: two soft lyre-like plucks and a mellow low wooden bell. Reassuring setback, ready to try again, no vocals.
